condition_other: spinal cord injury (T9 transection) with spasticity
readout_other: tail-pressure threshold for lower-limb spasm; proteomics of spinal cord tissue; Gap43 western blot
direction_notes: Neural activity was not recorded; four weeks of LIFU raised the pressure threshold for spasm in SCI rats and reduced Gap43 expression compared with untreated SCI rats.

timing.protocol_description: 1 MHz, PRF 0.8 kHz, duty cycle 20%, 20 min per day for 4 weeks, applied once daily under light isoflurane to the skin below the injury segment, starting on day 7 after SCI.

source_quotes.n_subjects: After 1 week of acclimatization, all rats were randomly divided into three groups (six per group)

flags.reason: Reported as 'irradiation intensity, 0.68 MPa' (a pressure); converted to 680 kPa; domain and peak/peak-to-peak not stated.
The stated 'treatment time, 20 min/d' is recorded as 1200 s; whether sonication was continuous within this time is not stated beyond the 20% duty cycle.
Daily for 4 weeks is stated but no session count; not computed.
Paper says behavioural testing was done in a 'blind' manner without stating who was blinded.
Probe described only as '1 MHz, DOBO; Changzhou, China'; no model name.
Treatment site is the skin over the spinal segment below the T9 transection; spinal level not further specified in Methods (Discussion mentions lumbar and sciatic segments).
